payload.ctor: Spacecraft() sets integrator = new svIntegratorRK4(this) -> the stock DEFAULT integrator is RK4 (the swap target).
UpdateState_order: integrateState (= preIntegration[all dynPtrs] -> integrator->integrate(timeBefore, timeStep) -> postIntegration[all dynPtrs]; skipped if isDynamicsSynced)
Reset_order: initializeDynamics (= createProperty mass/time props -> gravField.registerProperties -> hub.registerStates -> effector registerStates -> linkInStates -> updateSCMassProps -> B/C r/v correction -> effector linkInStates -> readOptionalRefMsg -> equationsOfMotion(0, 1))
setIntegrator_rules: takes ownership (destructor deletes); warns (not errors) if isDynamicsSynced
bskError on null; bskError unless new integrator was created with THIS DynamicObject (dynPtrs[0] check, no dynamic_cast)
old integrator's dynPtrs take priority (multi-sc sync preserved)
payload.integrate_args: integrate(timeBefore, timeStep) — NOT the tick time; the swap must use exactly these.

rw_registered_states.reactionWheelThetas: numRWJitter x 1 (only if any jitter wheel; JitterSimple or JitterFullyCoupled)

payload.stock_saturation_rule: |Omega| >= Omega_max && Omega_max > 0 && Omega*u_cmd >= 0 -> cut (ConfigureRWRequests; matches the omni direction-aware cut semantics).
payload.stock_rw_matrixD: matrixD -= Js*gs*gs^T (total-inertia semantics, matches omni Update-5).
payload.balanced_mass_props: BalancedWheels/JitterSimple contribute ZERO mass props (mEff=0); only JitterFullyCoupled adds mass/inertia.
payload.maxWheelAcceleration: CLAMP (not log-only): |OmegasDot| capped with BSK_WARNING; u_current back-solved for consistency. Answers the WP1 log-vs-clamp open question from source.
payload.hub_fast_path: useHubOnlyFastPath (no effectors + zero offset) takes computeHubOnlyDerivatives; pointMassTranslationalOnly is a separate translational path.
payload.diffusion: equationsOfMotionDiffusion delegates to equationsOfMotion (no real diffusion model) — stochastic integrators stay out of scope as planned.
